Class ItemStackRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.moddingx.libx.render.ItemStackRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.client.renderer.special.SpecialModelRenderer<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>
public class ItemStackRenderer extends Object implements net.minecraft.client.renderer.special.SpecialModelRenderer<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>
This class is meant to apply a BlockEntityRenderer to items. Using it is really straightforward:
  • Add custom SpecialModelRenderer to your item.
  • In Registerable.setupClient(SetupContext) call addRenderBlock(BlockEntityType, boolean)
Your item also needs a special item model. ItemModelProviderBase provides a method to generate that for you.
